about: Windows 11 hidden-icons flyout: icons only in a small grid, no header while no item is open; item flyouts without KDE's settings and pin buttons. Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13).

replacements.why: no text labels next to hidden icons
replacements.new: visible: false // VeltOS: icons only, like Windows 11

replacements.why: up to four icons per row
replacements.new: readonly property int columns: Math.max(1, Math.min(4, count)) // VeltOS: up to four per row
readonly property int delegateHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing * 2 // VeltOS

replacements.why: small flyouts: the icons only while no item is open, the drives list as a small menu as tall as its entries
replacements.new:
// VeltOS: as small as the icons need while no item is open (at most
    // four per row), and the drives list ("Safely Remove Hardware") as a
    // small flyout, like Windows.
    readonly property int veltosIconsWidth: hiddenItemsView.layout.cellHeight * Math.max(1, Math.min(4, hiddenItemsView.layout.itemCount)) + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
    readonly property int veltosIconsHeight: hiddenItemsView.layout.cellHeight * Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hiddenItemsView.layout.itemCount / 4)) + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
    // The clipboard flyout has its own heading ("Clipboard history",
    // "Clear all"), as Windows 11's clipboard history: no second one;
    // "Safely Remove Hardware" is a plain menu, as on Windows.
    readonly property bool veltosOwnHeading: !!systemTrayState.activeApplet
        && ["org.kde.plasma.clipboard", "org.kde.plasma.devicenotifier"]
               .includes(systemTrayState.activeApplet.plasmoid.pluginName)
    readonly property bool veltosSmallApplet: !!systemTrayState.activeApplet
        && systemTrayState.activeApplet.plasmoid.pluginName === "org.kde.plasma.devicenotifier"
    readonly property int veltosAppletWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * (veltosSmallApplet ? 16 : 24)
    // The drives menu is as tall as its entries.
    readonly property int veltosAppletHeight: veltosSmallApplet
        ? Math.min(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 24, Math.max(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 3,
              systemTrayState.activeApplet.fullRepresentationItem
                  ? systemTrayState.activeApplet.fullRepresentationItem.implicitHeight
                  : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10))
        : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 24
    Layout.minimumWidth: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? veltosAppletWidth : veltosIconsWidth
    Layout.minimumHeight: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? veltosAppletHeight : veltosIconsHeight
    Layout.preferredWidth: Layout.minimumWidth
    Layout.preferredHeight: Layout.minimumHeight
    Layout.maximumWidth: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? (veltosSmallApplet ? veltosAppletWidth : Infinity) : veltosIconsWidth
    Layout.maximumHeight: systemTrayState.activeApplet ? (veltosSmallApplet ? veltosAppletHeight : Infinity) : veltosIconsHeight
